name: Georgia
checked: 2026-10-09; 2026-10-10 by N10 (the reader's own requests through election/source.py)
status_why: Enhanced Voting answered scripts behind Cloudflare without a challenge.
system: Enhanced Voting (results.sos.ga.gov, 'Georgia Election Results'), the same platform as Virginia's; Cloudflare in front.

results_page.label: Georgia Secretary of State: election results

election.how_to_find: results/public/api/jurisdictions/Georgia (run_night.py discover) once a day from Oct 20.

feeds.address: https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/Georgia (list of elections with publicElectionId and electionDate; childLocalities); https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/api/elections/Georgia/<publicElectionId> (isOfficialResults, lastUpdated, report files); report files under https://results.sos.ga.gov/cdn/results/<guid>/<file> (e.g. 'Total Votes Results_<guid>.xlsx')
feeds.updates: Every few minutes on election night as counties upload; lastUpdated is in the election record.
feeds.note: jurisdictions/Georgia answered 200 JSON (44 KB) to a script on 2026-10-09, server cloudflare, no challenge.

feeds.address: https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/<shortName> for child localities (clayton-county-ga, dekalb-county-ga, gwinnett-county-ga and three more listed today); each has its own elections
feeds.note: Only 6 counties publish their own local contests on the state platform; other counties' local races are in the state election or on their own sites.

races_in_feed: Federal, statewide, legislature, PSC, judges (nonpartisan in May), county offices and many county and city contests that counties load into the state election; six counties have their own child sites.
local: Six counties are child sites on the same platform (Clayton, DeKalb, Gwinnett and three more). Fulton and Cobb post their own results pages too (addresses not checked today).
how_counted: Counties upload through the night. A race where no one wins a majority goes to a runoff on December 1.
count_order: Enhanced Voting reports by method (Election Day, Advance in Person, Absentee by Mail, Provisional); confirm on the 2024NovGen replay.
vote_types: Enhanced Voting reports by vote method (Election Day, Advance in Person, Absentee by Mail, Provisional) in its contest views and workbooks; confirm on the 2024NovGen replay.

rules.applies: general-election races for federal and state office

certify.rule: Not later than 5 p.m. on the 17th day after the election (Ga. Code 21-2-499(b)).
certify.local_rule: Counties certify by 5 p.m. on the Monday after the election (Ga. Code 21-2-493(k)).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: 2024NovGen (official general; Rehearsal 1) and GeneralPrimary51926 (2026 primary), both kept in election_cache/replay/sources/<code>-<id>/ (kept 2026-10-10 by N10 for rehearsals)
scout_blocked: The results site answers scripts. The candidate list (mvp.sos.ga.gov) is behind reCAPTCHA (John's save).
scout_plan: Live-readable. In the last week of October read jurisdictions/Georgia once a day until the Nov 3 election appears, then note its publicElectionId. On election night read the election record every 3 to 5 minutes and fetch its summary data when lastUpdated changes; Georgia's runoff rule (majority required, Dec 1 runoff) means 'leading' and 'advances to a runoff' must both be possible outcomes. Local races come from the same election and the six county child sites.
notes: Reader (N10, 2026-10-10): enhanced_voting. check() reads the election record's lastUpdated; fetch() reads <site>/results/public/api/elections/<j>/<id>/data (statewide totals, count groups, reporting units). The per-contest county breakdown (2.5 MB a contest) is not read.
